title: JD-Jones-ASES/fs-formal
summary: A Lean 4 formalization of an explicit construction for the Furstenberg-Sárközy problem. If D(N) is the largest size of a subset of {1,...,N} with no nonzero square difference, the development proves that an explicit eleven-block constant alphaInf is at most liminf log D(N)/log N, that every exponent below alphaInf holds eventually pointwise, and that 0.7537 < alphaInf. The proof includes the finite certificates, the composite even-digit lift, CRT gluing, asymptotic passage, and kernel-checked numerical inequalities. This strictly improves Krachun's preceding explicit exponent…
